verdict.rationale: Xero documents one concrete bulk operation (exporting a payment file to pay multiple bills at once) and provides API/SDK/MCP access that could theoretically be scripted for bulk actions, but there is no evidence of dedicated bulk API endpoints or MCP tools for batch-processing many invoices, contacts, or transactions at once. Missing for 10: documented bulk/batch API endpoints, MCP tool support for multi-item operations, and independent confirmation of bulk automation via AI agents.
